3025-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2390-5875-6191.description:
Gain life.
Essence Channeler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-3263-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
1315-3263-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.
1315-3263-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

67-2921-4053-7410.description:
Cast Rhys by paying {1}{W}
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Rhys.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, its ability and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Rhys from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Rhys enters, it triggers, giving Reveillark persist until end of turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

891-997-5617.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1903-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1903-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-2034-7198.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-2374-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-2374-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2604-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2604-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

2558-6351-6797--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-6351-6797--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

518-4285-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-4285-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

856-2981-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

618-4050-6473.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Siegebreaker.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Mardu Siegebreaker token, adding one mana of any color.
When the Mardu Siegebreaker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2201-2558-3698-5687.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1750-2793-5131-5261-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

4770-5115-5283-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
4770-5115-5283-5296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2713-4474-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Gilder Bairn.
Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4474-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

413-2178-4147-4294.manaNeeded: {5}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
413-2178-4147-4294.notablePrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
413-2178-4147-4294.description:
Cast Etali from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{R}{R} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 2.

380-703-851-2047.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Miirym.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating two token copies of Astral Dragon.
The Astral Dragon tokens enter the battlefield, creating eight token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger from step 2, creating four token copies of any noncreature artifact you control that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to and causing you to win the game.

2954-4067-5042.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three cards in hand with different names.
You control an Island.
2954-4067-5042.description:

Activate Ormos by paying {1}{U}{U} and discarding three cards with different names, causing you to draw ten cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discading a card, untapping the Island.
Activate the Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

You have enough mana available to cast Blasphemous Act.
